assessment.risk_reason: The feature makes a remote evaluation-data mutation and must prevent document, trace, credential, and local-path leakage.

dispatch.attempt_1: Built an explicit --upload-gated, fictional-only dataset-item adapter with offline fakes.
dispatch.attempt_2: Added root .env loading limited to the three Langfuse settings, with process environment precedence and an optional --env-file override.

outcome.behavior: The default command is a network-free validation. The upload command validates the exact reviewed ten-case schema then creates Langfuse dataset items with stable IDs, input, expected output, and metadata.
verification: 29 focused tests passed across uploader, fictional evaluator, and existing source-grounding evaluator.
Ruff check and format check passed for uploader files.
Mypy strict passed for the uploader.
The dry run reported a valid ten-item payload.
limitations: No real upload was attempted and no credentials were read during verification.
A Langfuse dashboard experiment requires a separate fictional-sample application adapter after dataset upload.
